title: Reveal Hero
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build'

checks.name: cursor spotlight and eased grid movement
mobile menu opens, closes, selects item, and handles Escape
No console errors or failed network requests
Exact remote images and Google Inter loaded

notes: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS; lucide-react icons. Required Supabase dependency included; no backend needed.
Source, lockfile, build, validation script, documentation, and screenshots are contained in this project.
Detailed evidence: screenshots/browser-report.json. Tablet layout also checked at 700x1000.
Mobile menu toggles, closes on item selection, and supports Escape. No destinations or flows were specified for other presentation buttons.
Images use the exact supplied URLs without downloading. Images and font remain external runtime dependencies.
Canvas mask follows the specified per-frame toDataURL algorithm; touch devices retain an initial centered reveal.
Ready for review; no deployment or push performed.
